steps.content: Human items are scattered all over the depths of the nest. You try to check them out, but eventually give up because they make you vomit repeatedly. You can only proceed on foot.
There are thousands upon millions of Mutant Bugs, but they no longer attack you. Their tiny insect eyes glow in the dark, watching you, quivering and rustling...
Though still fragmented, they are communicating with you in human language that can be fully understood.

steps.speaker: Mutant Bug
steps.content: ...We... are weak... Here... we can't fight against more terrifying beings... we... can't embrace the Ultimate End...

steps.speaker: Mutant Bug
steps.content: But the weak can huddle for warmth... when tiny bugs gather to form a swarm, we can also become strong... and survive...

steps.speaker: Mutant Bug
steps.content: ...The yearning for companions... the yearning to be part of a group... this kind of determination turned into Mantis...

They're speaking in human language, yet it feels like some kind of malicious and clumsy imitation, making you instinctively vigilant and resentful. The naturalist's years of thought are now spoken out of these alien mouths.
You are... looking for me?

A gust of wind suddenly blows from behind you. Just as you're about to turn around, a green light flashes. Two huge scythes cut through the darkness, forcefully clamping your arms and lifting you up. A cold, rugged shell presses painfully against your back.
A woman's voice mixed with the nauseating sound of trembling mouthparts rings in your ear.
I am Mantis...
Your... companion...

Your shackles blast off a corner of the bug nest, but you are violently thrown into the air and land heavily on the other side. Two scythes pin down your wrists, pressing you hard against the hard, uneven filth of the bug nest.
<color=#dg1f1f><i>Hee hee hee hee, yes, and no... Not yet, at least.
<color=#dg1f1f><i>You are still... human. Humans... are much weaker than Mantises.
Having been struck to the point of almost vomiting blood, you have no strength left to resist. The owner of the scythes slowly approaches from the darkness, revealing her figure.
...Unlike all the other Mutant Bugs, this monster actually has a somewhat human form. The familiar stature and green hair of the woman chills you to the bone.

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: ...The human heart is complex, yet... fragile and easy to break... It is contradictory... and unpredictable...

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: It's why "I," regrettably born from you... have different forms, unstable, and not strong enough...

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: I want... to fix myself... a spirit similar to mine, a more determined will... I need... a true anchor of my own...

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: I want the Perishing Star...or you...

You indeed sense the scholar's aura on her. On the bright side, at least she can converse, and still remembers her theories. Maybe... you can still awaken her. Think... think carefully what you should do...
She comes close to your neck, sniffing like an animal, her mouthparts quivering. She sticks out her tongue to lick the cold sweat seeping from you and laughs tremulously.
...This is the affection of a predator. A chill rushes to your head, and your shackles strike aside the greedy-faced monster, but she simply laughs as she leaps into the air.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Release the humans you've captured! Give me back my companions! Otherwise, I'll tear down your bug nest and kill you!

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: Hee hee hee hee hee... so you want companions too, like us.

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: You fear loneliness and weakness... hence you yearn to be part of a group, to be protected by those stronger than you...

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: You and I... Humans and Mantises... In this respect, we're all the same... The companion you're looking for shares the same feelings as us...

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: I enjoy talking to her very much. I like her a lot.
An ominous premonition surges in your heart.

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: Here, in the swarm, in my heart.

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: ...Turn ...around.
Behind you, the rock-hard filth suddenly throbs like a monstrous heartbeat and turns soft, slowly wrapping around your hand.
Your mind goes blank, and your body rigidly turns around.
The previously dark and rock-hard filth is now glowing, revealing a semi-transparent, jelly-like outer wall. It resembles a huge egg, but also looks like it's dissolving and digesting something.
You can vaguely see something soaking inside...

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: Humans... are weak... but not all are weak...

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: In those frail shells, there occasionally are... strong, steadfast, unwavering spirits...

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: That's what we need...
You touch the semi-transparent outer wall with trembling fingers, trying to discern the mess within the egg. They have already been dissolved, but you know what's inside.

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: She wanted to converse with me. She came searching for companions, too. Apart from her weak body and fleeting lifespan... she's very much like me.

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: So, I brought her to the companions she was looking for. I made her my "companion." We became stronger together. Isn't that good?

steps.speaker: Mantis Queen
steps.content: She became me. From now on, we will embrace the Perishing Star together.
